result.scope: Font boxes and raster paper-edge checks, not PDF/UA certification or semantic glyph verification.

semantic_limits: Script-enabled article pages have one closed-popup aria-controls incomplete rule per page, not a violation. IDs resolve; keyboard-open populated popup state and empty searches receive separate manual/state-aware checks.
Whole-site semantic counts are in semantics-summary.json; contrast and painted focus outlines use independent checks.
scientific_limits: Constructed standard-library, Decimal, NumPy/SciPy calculations and fixed-source recording stubs; no policy training, hardware queue/servo execution or paper benchmark reproduction.
Contact v1 printed kernel convention remains unresolved; both literal normalized weights and an explicitly defined standard-deviation Gaussian are distinguished.
RMA simulation-step/history-index discrepancies are recorded without inventing a resolved original implementation.
Contact VII-B action-count prose disagrees with TableII; both are identified and no ratio is inferred from the mismatched summary.

manual_native_review.findings: RMA phase2 arrow/caption, RMA trial stopping, UMI unequal N and shortened source-method label read without clipping.
Target-noise clarification, formula and primary citation read without clipping.
Original prose/TableII action-count discrepancy reads without clipping and leaves source table values intact.
